prompts.title: Meadow Light
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original baked-in background image for the Cycle personal journal app; artwork only, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: Feminine, soft, pretty, refined and restful, with a distinct but subdued color identity. Create one square high-resolution image, preferably 2048 by 2048 pixels.
Style/medium: premium contemporary watercolor and softly painted illustration, translucent washes, delicate natural detail, subtle fine paper texture, diffused light. Elegant rather than sugary or childish.
Composition/framing: full bleed, a quiet softly colored center occupying roughly 60 percent of the image, with graceful motifs toward the outer areas and some near the top/bottom so phone and desktop crops both retain character. No rigid decorative frame. Soft tonal variation in the center is welcome. Details should stay subordinate to journal cards placed above it.
Constraints: one finished image only, no collage, no comparison board, no text, letters, numbers, labels, typography, logo, watermark, interface, borders, human figures, harsh black, heavy outlines, busy repeating pattern, oversaturated colors, glitter or high-contrast central focal point. Opaque background. Do not write the palette or option name in the artwork.
Palette name (not text to render): Buttercup Morning.
Option name (not text to render): Meadow Light.
Scene/backdrop: a light buttery-yellow morning wash with a few delicate buttercup flowers and fine stems rising from the lower outer areas. Open petals catch creamy sunlight; occasional loose petals float near an upper edge. Spacious and airy, no dense bouquet.
Color palette: soft butter yellow, pale lemon, warm ivory, a restrained touch of desaturated light sage in stems. The overall color must clearly read yellow, not beige or orange.
